summary: Saturn's own sub-period at the start of its mahadasha (about 3 years) is described by Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman as a heavy time: illness, mental anguish, losses to rulers and thieves, and suffering in the family, with some gains through farming and servants. BPHS makes it excellent (high position, family happiness, land and conveyances) when Saturn is in its own or exaltation sign, in a kendra or trikona, or a yogakaraka. When Saturn is in the 8th or 12th it starts badly and ends well, and when Saturn is a maraka it warns of danger to life.
common_outcomes: growth of farming, servants and buffalo herds, money through a labourer, friendship with an older woman, laziness and wrongdoing, wind illness (Phaladeepika 21.48)
disease and suffering, envy and pride leading to sorrow, loss of wealth and grain to rulers and robbers (Jataka Parijata 18.122)
opposition, displeasure of officials, fear of cattle being poisoned, suffering of wife and children, fever, wind or phlegm ailments, colic (Jataka Parijata 18.123)
disease, mental anguish, losses to rulers and robbers, family quarrels, disputes with relatives, loss of money (Raman p. 261)
rare_outcomes: a kingdom or command of an army through the ruler's favour (BPHS 57.1-3 when well placed)
loss of children, mental derangement (Raman p. 261)
[maraka: BPHS 57.6 predicts premature death when Saturn is the 2nd or 7th lord]

by_area.personality: Laziness and wrongdoing (Phaladeepika 21.48); envy and pride leading to sorrow (Jataka Parijata 18.122); mental agony in the middle of the period when Saturn is badly placed (BPHS 57.4-5).
by_area.career: High position, command of an army through the ruler's favour when well placed (BPHS 57.1-3); fear of the government when in the 8th/12th (BPHS 57.4); displeasure of officials (Jataka Parijata 18.123).
by_area.finance: Gains of land, villages and cattle when well placed (BPHS 57.1-3); growth of farming and money through labourers (Phaladeepika 21.48); loss of wealth and grain to rulers and robbers (Jataka Parijata 18.122; Raman).
by_area.health: Wind illness (Phaladeepika 21.48); fever, wind and phlegm ailments, colic (Jataka Parijata 18.123); weapon injuries, bleeding, abdominal swelling (gulma) and dysentery at the start when badly placed (BPHS 57.4-5); blood and bile complaints (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children when well placed (BPHS 57.1-3); suffering of wife and children (Jataka Parijata 18.123).
by_area.family: Family quarrels and disputes with relatives (Raman p. 261); leaving home in the middle of the period when badly placed (BPHS 57.5).

strengtheners: Saturn in its own sign or exaltation, especially deep exaltation (BPHS 57.1-3)
Saturn in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, or a yogakaraka (BPHS 57.1-3)
Saturn in its moolatrikona or Libra, in the 11th, or with a rajayoga (BPHS 57.1, Sanskrit gloss)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn in the 8th or 12th from the lagna, or debilitated with malefics (BPHS 57.4-5)
Saturn as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 57.6)
lagna_or_context_notes: Here Saturn is both dasa and sub-period lord, so BPHS judges it only from the lagna and by dignity. Saturn rules the 2nd or 7th for Cancer, Leo, Sagittarius and Capricorn lagnas, and the maraka warning of 57.6 applies to those. The web Sanskrit gloss labels verses 1-5 as about Rahu, but verse 6 names Saturn's sub-period and Santhanam heads the section Saturn-Saturn.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.1-7, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if Saturn is in its own sign, exalted or deeply exalted, in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, or a yogakaraka: high position, happiness from wife and children, conveyances, clothes, command of an army, cattle, villages and land. In the 8th or 12th from the lagna, or debilitated with malefics: at the start, fear of government, weapon injuries, bleeding, gulma, dysentery; in the middle, thieves, leaving home, mental agony; the end is good. As 2nd or 7th lord: danger of premature death; relief through Mrityunjaya japa, by Shiva's grace.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.1-7, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 1 lists moolatrikona, own sign, Libra (exaltation), a kendra, trikona or the 11th, and rajayoga as the good conditions. Verse 4 adds weakness to the bad ones. Verse 6 says Saturn's sub-period becomes auspicious at its end.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 21.48 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Growth in farming, servants and buffaloes; wind illness; much money through a labourer; friendship with an old woman; laziness; sinful acts.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 18.122-123 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri vol. 2)
source_views.view: 18.122: disease and suffering, sorrow from envy and pride, loss of wealth and grain to kings and robbers. 18.123: opposition, displeasure of the king's men, keeping old women servants, fear of cattle being poisoned, suffering of wife and children, fever, wind or phlegm ailments, colic.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, p. 261
source_views.view: 3 years 3 days. Disease, troubles and torments, mental anguish, losses to rulers and robbers, fear of poison to cattle, family suffering, fever, wind, phlegm, colic, loss of money and children, serious enmities, disputes with relatives, blood and bile complaints, mental derangement.

disagreements: BPHS gives a fully favourable version under good dignity or house; the other classical texts and Raman describe this sub-period as largely troublesome with no conditions. Santhanam lists own sign, exaltation, kendra/trikona and yogakaraka. The Sanskrit gloss adds moolatrikona, the 11th and rajayoga. For the bad case Santhanam reads 'associated with malefics in debilitation'; the gloss lists weak, debilitated or with malefics as separate conditions.
phrasing_guidance: Frame this as the demanding opening of a long, slow period that rewards patience. Advise care with health, money and dealings with officials. If the chart has the BPHS good conditions, lead with the favourable version. Do not predict death or loss of children.

summary: Mercury's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 2 years 8 months 9 days) is one of the better parts of the period in every source: reputation, wealth, comforts, pilgrimage and religious activity, and gains through trade. BPHS makes it good when Mercury is in a kendra or trikona. When Mercury is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn, or with the Sun, Mars or Rahu, there are gains at the start and illness and failures later. As 2nd or 7th lord, Mercury brings bodily distress.
common_outcomes: prosperity, contentment, female company, favour from the ruler, victory and help from friends (Phaladeepika 21.49)
more happiness, wealth and fame; merit from piety; gains through agriculture and commerce (Jataka Parijata 18.124)
charitable works, wealth, birth of children, more knowledge, favour of superiors, general prosperity (Raman p. 261)
rare_outcomes: rajayoga or headship of a village (BPHS 57.9, 57.12)
bathing at Setu (Rameshwaram) on pilgrimage (BPHS 57.10, Sanskrit gloss)
illness from all three humours; trouble to siblings and children (Phaladeepika 21.49)

by_area.personality: Enthusiasm and bodily well-being when Mercury is well placed (BPHS 57.10); anxiety and fear in the middle and end when it is badly placed (BPHS 57.13).
by_area.career: Respect from the public, good reputation and rajayoga (BPHS 57.8-9); favour of superiors (Raman); failure in ventures later in the period if Mercury is afflicted (BPHS 57.13).
by_area.finance: Gain of wealth, conveyances (BPHS 57.8-9); wealth from trade, agriculture and commerce (Jataka Parijata 18.124; Sanskrit gloss of BPHS 57.11).
by_area.health: Bodily comfort when well placed (BPHS 57.10); disease in the middle and end when afflicted (BPHS 57.13); physical distress as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.14); illness from the three humours (Phaladeepika 21.49).
by_area.family: Well-being in the family (BPHS 57.10); trouble to siblings and children (Phaladeepika 21.49); success to relatives (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Religious sacrifices, pilgrimage, listening to Puranas, charity and food donation (BPHS 57.9-11); acts of piety and customary observances (Jataka Parijata 18.124; Raman).

strengtheners: Mercury in a kendra or trikona (BPHS 57.8)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn, or with the Sun, Mars or Rahu (BPHS 57.12)
Mercury debilitated or combust (BPHS 57.12, Sanskrit gloss)
Mercury as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.14)
Mercury 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS uses two reference points here: Mercury's house from the lagna (vv. 8, 12) and from Saturn (v. 12). Santhanam doubts that good results can come even at the start when Mercury is so badly placed. Mercury and Saturn are natural friends, which fits the generally good reports.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.8-15, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if Mercury is in a kendra or trikona from the lagna: respect, reputation, wealth, conveyances, religious sacrifices, rajayoga, bodily comfort, enthusiasm, family well-being, pilgrimage, Puranas, charity, sweet food. If Mercury is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn, or with the Sun, Mars and Rahu: at the start high position, wealth and headship of a village; in the middle and end disease, failure in all ventures, anxiety and fear. As 2nd or 7th lord: physical distress. Remedies: Vishnu Sahasranama and charity of grams.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.8-15, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 12 also names debilitation and combustion as bad conditions. Verse 11 adds wealth from trade. Verse 14 speaks of affliction of the 2nd or 7th lord bringing bodily trouble. Verse 15 gives the remedy as Vishnu Sahasranama and food donation.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 21.49 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Good fortune and pleasant appearance, contentment, women's company, royal favour, victory and allies; but illness from the three humours and illness of siblings and children.

source_views.view: 2y 8m 9d. Charitable works, wealth, birth of children, more knowledge, prosperity to children, success to relatives, favour of superiors, more happiness, wealth and fame, merit from piety, agriculture and commerce.

disagreements: BPHS (and Santhanam's own doubt) give good results at the start even when Mercury is badly placed; the other texts give no such phase. Phaladeepika adds illness and trouble to siblings and children to an otherwise good list; Jataka Parijata and Raman give only good results.
phrasing_guidance: Present this as a constructive phase for reputation, trade, learning and religious life. Where the chart shows the BPHS affliction, add that early gains may fade and advise caution later in the period. Do not predict death from the maraka examples.

summary: Ketu's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 1 year 1 month 9 days) is described as a troubled time in every source: loss of position, fear, poverty, foreign travel, quarrels with wife and children, wind and fever illness, and danger from snakes or poison. In Santhanam's reading BPHS holds this even when Ketu is well placed. Relief comes if Ketu is linked to the lagna lord, or in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th from Saturn. In the 8th or 12th it warns of danger to life.
common_outcomes: wind and fire ailments, harassment by enemies, constant quarrels with sons and wife, misfortune, danger from snakes (Phaladeepika 21.50)
wind and bile disease, quarrels with wicked people, bad dreams (Jataka Parijata 18.125)
rheumatism or sickness, danger of poison, trouble from sons, loss of money, quarrels with low people, bad dreams, family quarrels (Raman pp. 261-262)
loss of position, danger, poverty, distress, foreign journeys (BPHS 57.16-18)
rare_outcomes: imprisonment, loss of children or spouse (BPHS 57.17, Sanskrit gloss)
bathing in holy rivers and visiting shrines (BPHS 57.18-19)
[maraka: BPHS 57.20-21 predicts fear of premature death when Ketu is in the 8th or 12th]

by_area.personality: Religious thoughts, strength and courage when Ketu is well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.19); fear and distress otherwise (BPHS 57.16).
by_area.career: Loss of position and suffering on behalf of one's master (BPHS 57.16-18); audience with rulers when Ketu is well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.19).
by_area.finance: Poverty and loss of money (BPHS 57.17; Raman); wealth at the start if Ketu is linked to the lagna lord (BPHS 57.18).
by_area.health: Wind and fire or bile ailments (Phaladeepika 21.50; Jataka Parijata 18.125); cold fever, dysentery, wounds, poor food in the 8th/12th (BPHS 57.20-21); physical distress in the 2nd/7th (BPHS 57.22).
by_area.relationships: Constant quarrels with wife and sons (Phaladeepika 21.50); separation from wife and children in the 8th/12th (BPHS 57.21).
by_area.family: Family quarrels and trouble from sons (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Bathing in holy rivers and visiting shrines when Ketu is linked to the lagna lord or well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.18-19).

strengtheners: Ketu related to the lagna lord (BPHS 57.18)
Ketu in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th from Saturn (BPHS 57.19)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in the 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn (BPHS 57.20-21)
Ketu in the 2nd or 7th from the lagna (BPHS 57.22)
Ketu 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
lagna_or_context_notes: In Santhanam's reading of BPHS 57.16-18, Ketu gives evil even when it is exalted, in its own or a benefic sign, in a kendra or trikona, or with benefics, unless it is related to the lagna lord. The Sanskrit gloss reads verse 16 as listing favourable conditions and verse 17 as warning that a kendra or trikona Ketu can still bring loss. Only Ketu's relation to Saturn (kendra, trikona, 3rd, 11th) is given as clearly good.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.16-23, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Loss of position, dangers, poverty, distress, foreign journeys even if Ketu is exalted, in its own or a benefic sign, in a kendra or trikona, or with benefics. If related to the lagna lord: wealth, enjoyment, holy baths and pilgrimage at the start. In a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from Saturn: strength, courage, religious thoughts, audience with rulers, enjoyments. In the 8th or 12th from the lagna or Saturn: fear of premature death, coarse food, cold fever, dysentery, wounds, thieves, separation from wife and children. In the 2nd or 7th from the lagna: physical distress. Remedy: give a goat in charity.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.16-23, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 17 lists loss of position, great fear, poverty, imprisonment and loss of children or wife even with Ketu in a kendra or trikona. Verse 18 adds suffering for one's master and foreign travel. Verse 23 says the goat gift (chaga-dana) averts untimely death.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 21.50 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Wind and fire ailments, harassment by enemies, constant quarrels with sons and wife, bad omens, danger from snakes.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 18.125 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri vol. 2)
source_views.view: Wind and bile disease, quarrels with vile people, dread of evil dreams.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, pp. 261-262
source_views.view: 1y 1m 9d. Rheumatism or sickness, danger of poison, danger from sons, loss of money, quarrels with low people, evil dreams, family quarrels.

source_views.view: Example only: an extra-marital tie formed in Saturn-Mercury was ended in Saturn-Ketu; Rath reads Ketu as Ganapati, which does not tolerate such ties.

disagreements: Santhanam reads BPHS 57.16 as 'evil even if well placed'; the Sanskrit gloss reads verse 16 as favourable conditions and verse 17 as the contrary warning. All other texts give only adverse results.
phrasing_guidance: Describe this as a short, unsettled phase that favours simplicity, spiritual practice and careful health habits. Mention relief or pilgrimage only when the chart has the listed links to the lagna lord or to Saturn. Do not predict premature death, imprisonment or loss of family.

summary: Venus's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 3 years 2 months) is generally the best part of the period: marriage, children, wealth, good health, honours and goodwill of relatives. BPHS makes it good when Venus is in a kendra, trikona or the 11th with benefics, or in the 9th, 11th or a kendra from Saturn. It is bad when Venus is debilitated, combust or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn. Uttara Kalamrita adds a reversal: when both Venus and Saturn are very strong, their mutual periods can ruin even a king.
common_outcomes: contentment with friends, wife and children; wealth from farming and sea or river travel; wide renown (Phaladeepika 21.51)
goodwill of relatives, public approval, gain of wives, property and wealth, joys of agriculture (Jataka Parijata 18.126)
general happiness, favours and gifts, business profits, more family members, victory over enemies, wife's property (Raman p. 262)
rare_outcomes: a kingdom or high office by the ruler's grace (BPHS 57.25-26)
composition of poetry and study of Vedanta (BPHS 57.31)
the native ruined even if born a king, when both Venus and Saturn are strong (Uttara Kalamrita sec. 6, sl. 28.5-29.5)

by_area.personality: Interest in shastras, poetry and Vedanta (BPHS 57.31); mental agony when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 57.29).
by_area.career: High office and honours by the ruler's favour (BPHS 57.25-26); loss of position and friction with officials when Venus is badly placed (BPHS 57.29, 57.34).
by_area.finance: Wealth, clothes, ornaments, conveyances (BPHS 57.25-27); business profits (Raman); wealth from agriculture and water travel (Phaladeepika 21.51).
by_area.health: Sound health when well placed (BPHS 57.25); eye trouble, fevers, dental problems, heart disease, pain in the arms, danger from drowning or falls when Venus is 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn (BPHS 57.32-34); physical distress as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.35).
by_area.relationships: Marriage, birth of a son, happiness with wife and children (BPHS 57.24-25, 57.31; Phaladeepika 21.51; Jataka Parijata 18.126); distress to the wife when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 57.28-29).
by_area.family: Well-being in the family (BPHS 57.25); quarrels with close relations and brothers when afflicted (BPHS 57.29, 57.34); goodwill of relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.126).
by_area.spirituality: Charity, religious rites, Puranas and Vedanta when Venus is well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.30-31).

strengtheners: Venus in a kendra, trikona or the 11th, with or aspected by benefics (BPHS 57.24-27)
Venus exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.24, Sanskrit gloss)
Venus in the 9th, 11th or a kendra from Saturn (BPHS 57.30-31)
favourable transit of Jupiter or Saturn during the sub-period (BPHS 57.27)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus debilitated, combust, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 57.28-29)
Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn (BPHS 57.32-34)
Venus as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.35)
Venus and Saturn both very strong (Uttara Kalamrita sec. 6, sl. 28.5-29.5)
Venus 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
lagna_or_context_notes: Venus and Saturn are natural friends and are each other's yogakaraka-type lords for Taurus and Libra lagnas. Uttara Kalamrita reverses the usual rule for this pair. The commentator of the P.S. Sastri edition (ch. VI) finds the rule valid in essence but modified by lordship, placement and aspects, and cites charts where well-placed mutual periods still harmed health.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.24-36, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if Venus is in a kendra, trikona or the 11th with or aspected by benefics: marriage, birth of a son, wealth, health, family well-being, high position, honours, clothes, ornaments, conveyances. Favourable Jupiter transit brings fortune and property; favourable Saturn transit brings rajayoga or yoga rites. Debilitated, combust or 6th/8th/12th from the lagna: distress to the wife, loss of position, mental agony, quarrels with relations. In the 9th, 11th or a kendra from Saturn: ambitions fulfilled through the ruler, charity, religious rites, shastras, poetry, Vedanta, happiness from wife and children. 6th/8th/12th from Saturn: eye trouble, fevers, loss of good conduct, dental and heart trouble, pain in the arms, danger of drowning or a fall from a tree, friction with relatives, officials and brothers. As 2nd or 7th lord: physical distress. Remedies: Durga Saptashati and the gift of a cow or female buffalo.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.24-36, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 24 lists exalted, own sign, kendra, with benefics, trikona or labha as alternatives. Verse 28 adds an enemy sign to the bad conditions. Verse 36 specifies a white cow or buffalo, for longevity and health, by the grace of Jagadamba.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 21.51 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Happiness with friends, wife and children; more wealth from farming and sea travel; wide good reputation.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 18.126 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri vol. 2)
source_views.view: Goodwill of relatives, approval of the people, gain of wives, property and wealth, joys of agriculture.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I sec. 6, sl. 28.5-30.5 (English edition on archive.org; P.S. Sastri tr. ch. VI)
source_views.view: If Venus and Saturn are both exalted, in their own signs or vargottama and equally strong, their mutual periods make even a king a powerless beggar; if one is strong and the other weak, the stronger gives the yoga. If both are weak and 6th/8th/12th from each other, or own such houses or are joined with their lords, the periods are auspicious and give wealth and happiness. If one rules a good house and the other a bad one, results are still good, and if both are malefics they are very favourable.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, p. 262
source_views.view: 3y 2m. Auspicious; general happiness, attention and favours, gifts, business profits, more family members, victory over enemies, success, goodwill of relatives, wife's property and wealth.

disagreements: BPHS, Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman treat a strong Venus as good. Uttara Kalamrita says that when both Venus and Saturn are strong (exalted, own sign or vargottama) their mutual periods are disastrous, and that weakness and mutual 6/8/12 placement give good results. This is the reverse of BPHS 57.32-34. Santhanam requires benefic association with the kendra/trikona/11th placement; the Sanskrit gloss lists each as a separate good condition.
phrasing_guidance: Present this as usually the most pleasant phase of Saturn's period, good for marriage, family and comforts. If the chart has both Venus and Saturn very strong, mention the classical warning gently as a reason for caution with fortune and health, not as ruin. Avoid predicting harm to the spouse.

summary: The Sun's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 11 months 12 days) is one of the hardest in the general texts: danger from enemies and rulers, illness of elders, eye and stomach disease, loss of wealth, and trouble to wife and children. Saturn and the Sun are enemies. BPHS makes it good (good relations with superiors, family well-being, conveyances) when the Sun is exalted, in its own sign, with the 9th lord, or in a kendra or trikona with benefics. It is bad when the Sun is in the 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn.
common_outcomes: danger from enemies at all times, illness of elders, stomach and eye disease, loss of money and grain (Phaladeepika 21.52)
loss of wife and children, trouble from the king or robbers, sinking of heart (Jataka Parijata 18.127)
trouble from rulers or robbers, heart weakness, blood and intestinal disorders, eye trouble, illness of wife and children (Raman p. 262)
rare_outcomes: [maraka: Phaladeepika 21.52 and Raman p. 262 speak of danger of death]
fear of death to the father-in-law (Raman p. 262)
royal favour, wealth and happiness when both Saturn and the Sun are strong (Uttara Kalamrita sec. 6, sl. 30.5-31.5)

by_area.personality: Mental agony, fears and anxiety when the Sun is badly placed (BPHS 57.39-41); sinking of heart (Jataka Parijata 18.127).
by_area.career: Good relations with the employer when well placed (BPHS 57.37); defamation, loss of position and obstacles in industry when badly placed (BPHS 57.39-41); trouble from rulers (Jataka Parijata; Raman).
by_area.finance: Conveyances and cattle when well placed (BPHS 57.37-38); loss of money and grain (Phaladeepika 21.52); loss of cherished things (BPHS 57.41).
by_area.health: Heart disease and fevers (BPHS 57.39-41); stomach and eye disease (Phaladeepika 21.52); blood and intestinal disorders (Raman); physical distress as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.42).
by_area.relationships: Loss of or trouble to wife and children (Jataka Parijata 18.127; Raman); happiness from children when well placed (BPHS 57.37).
by_area.family: Illness of elders (Phaladeepika 21.52); separation from close relatives and loss of kinsmen when badly placed (BPHS 57.39-41).

strengtheners: the Sun exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.37)
the Sun associated with the 9th lord (BPHS 57.37)
the Sun in a kendra or trikona with or aspected by benefics (BPHS 57.37-38)
Saturn and the Sun both in own or exalted signs or navamsas, or in or ruling kendras and trikonas (Uttara Kalamrita sec. 6, sl. 30.5-31.5)
weakeners_or_cancellations: the Sun in the 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn (BPHS 57.39-41)
the Sun as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.42)
Saturn and the Sun both functional malefics (Uttara Kalamrita sec. 6, sl. 30.5-31.5)
the Sun 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
lagna_or_context_notes: The Sun owns only Leo, so the 2nd/7th-lord rule applies for Cancer and Aquarius lagnas. Santhanam's verse 37 has 'in kendra or trikona from the Ascendant associated with or aspected by benefics'; the Sanskrit gloss also lists the 11th. The gloss of verse 39 adds the lagna itself to the 8th and 12th as bad places.

In the 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn: heart disease, defamation, loss of position, mental agony, separation from relatives, obstacles in industry, fevers, fears, loss of kinsmen and cherished things. As 2nd or 7th lord: physical distress. Remedy: worship of the Sun.

summary: The Moon's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 1 year 7 months) is mixed: the general texts give illness, grief, death of an elder woman, family disputes and loss alongside some money and cattle. BPHS makes it good when the Moon is full, exalted, in its own sign, in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from Saturn, or aspected by benefics. It is bad when the Moon is waning, afflicted by malefics or debilitated. When the Moon is weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn, it brings lethargy, loss of position and enemies.
common_outcomes: loss of the wife or danger to life, trouble with friends, disease, fear from water and wind (Phaladeepika 21.53)
death of a revered elder woman, sorrow, dislike of relatives, income, wind disease (Jataka Parijata 18.128)
more cattle, enmity of friends and relatives, colds, family disputes, loss of money and property, mortgage and later recovery of property (Raman p. 262)
rare_outcomes: conveyances, garments and ornaments through a great ruler (BPHS 57.43-44)
happiness in both maternal and paternal homes (BPHS 57.45)
[maraka: Phaladeepika 21.53 speaks of danger to life]

by_area.personality: Great distress and anger when the Moon is weak or afflicted (BPHS 57.46-47); sleepiness and lethargy when weak and 6/8/12 from Saturn (BPHS 57.51-52); sorrow (Jataka Parijata 18.128).
by_area.career: Favour of rulers when well placed (BPHS 57.44); losses in business and loss of position when afflicted (BPHS 57.47-48, 57.51-52).
by_area.finance: Conveyances, garments, ornaments and cattle when well placed (BPHS 57.43-45); losses in business (BPHS 57.48); mortgage of property and later recovery (Raman).
by_area.health: Irregular meals and medicines when afflicted (BPHS 57.48); disease and fear from water and wind (Phaladeepika 21.53); wind disease (Jataka Parijata 18.128); lethargy and physical distress as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.53).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife when well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.49-50); loss or danger to the wife (Phaladeepika 21.53).
by_area.family: Happiness from parents, care of siblings when well placed (BPHS 57.43-45, 57.49-50); separation from parents and illness of children when afflicted (BPHS 57.47); death of an elder woman (Jataka Parijata 18.128).

strengtheners: the Moon full, exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.43)
the Moon in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from Saturn (BPHS 57.43, 57.49)
the Moon aspected by benefics, especially Jupiter (BPHS 57.43, Sanskrit gloss)
weakeners_or_cancellations: the Moon waning, with or aspected by malefics, debilitated, or in a malefic sign or navamsa (BPHS 57.46-48)
the Moon weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn (BPHS 57.51-52)
the Moon as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.53)
the Moon 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
lagna_or_context_notes: The Moon owns only Cancer, so the 2nd/7th-lord rule applies for Gemini and Capricorn lagnas. BPHS judges the good placements here from Saturn, not from the lagna. Santhanam doubts the text's statement that even an afflicted Moon gives some good at the start.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.43-54, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if the Moon is full, exalted, in its own sign, in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from Saturn, or aspected by benefics: conveyances, garments, ornaments, better fortune, care of siblings, happiness in both parents' homes, more cattle. If waning, with or aspected by malefics, debilitated, or in a malefic sign or navamsa: great distress, anger, separation from parents, illness of children, business losses, irregular meals, medicines; but some good and gains at the start. In a kendra, trikona or 11th from Saturn: conveyances, happiness from kin, parents, wife and employer. Weak and 6th/8th/12th from Saturn: sleepiness, lethargy, loss of position, more enemies, friction with kin. As 2nd or 7th lord: lethargy and physical distress. Remedies: homa and gifts of jaggery, ghee, curd-rice, a cow or female buffalo.

summary: Mars's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 1 year 1 month 9 days) is described in the general texts as a time of strife: loss of position, family disputes, serious illness, fever, danger from fire or weapons, more enemies and distress to brothers. BPHS makes it good from the start (wealth, government favour, command, farming, a new house) when Mars is exalted, in its own sign, or with the lagna lord or Saturn. It is bad when Mars is debilitated or combust, or in the 8th or 12th with malefics. When Mars is in the 2nd or rules the 7th or 8th, it warns of danger to life.
common_outcomes: loss of position, family disputes, serious illness, fever, danger from fire, weapons or poison, more enemies, hernia, eye trouble (Phaladeepika 21.54)
loss of place, serious illness, many fears, distress of brothers and friends (Jataka Parijata 18.129)
disgrace, serious enmity, strife, wandering, unsettled life, loss by fraud or theft, change of residence, serious illness, distress to brothers, hot diseases (Raman p. 263)
rare_outcomes: command of an army and construction of a new house (BPHS 57.57)
[maraka: BPHS 57.61 predicts fear of premature death when Mars is in the 2nd or lord of the 7th or 8th]

by_area.personality: Great distress and dependence on others when Mars is in the 2nd or rules the 7th/8th (BPHS 57.61).
by_area.career: Government favour and command when Mars is strong (BPHS 57.55-57); loss of position (Phaladeepika 21.54; Jataka Parijata 18.129); disgrace (Raman).
by_area.finance: Wealth, conveyances, ornaments, farming and cattle, a new house when strong (BPHS 57.55-57); loss of wealth, thieves and needless spending when afflicted (BPHS 57.58-60); loss by fraud or theft (Raman).
by_area.health: Wounds, weapons, snakes, gout (BPHS 57.58-59); fever, fire, hernia, eye trouble (Phaladeepika 21.54); hot diseases (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Quarrels with co-partners when Mars is afflicted (BPHS 57.59).
by_area.family: Happiness to kin when Mars is strong (BPHS 57.57); distress to father and brothers and loss of kinsmen when afflicted (BPHS 57.59); family disputes (Phaladeepika 21.54).

strengtheners: Mars exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.55)
Mars with the lagna lord or with Saturn (BPHS 57.55-56)
Mars in a kendra, trikona or the 11th (BPHS 57.55, Sanskrit gloss)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars debilitated or combust (BPHS 57.58)
Mars in the 8th or 12th from the lagna with or aspected by malefics (BPHS 57.58)
Mars in the 2nd, or lord of the 7th or 8th (BPHS 57.61)
Mars 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
lagna_or_context_notes: Mars and Saturn are natural enemies. Santhanam's verse 61 reads Mars 'in the 2nd or lord of the 7th or 8th'; the Sanskrit gloss reads it as the 8th or 7th lord in the 2nd. Mars rules the 7th for Libra and Taurus lagnas and the 8th for Aries and Virgo lagnas.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.55-62, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: From the very start, if Mars is exalted, in its own sign, or with the lagna lord or Saturn: enjoyments, wealth, government favour, conveyances, clothes, ornaments, command of an army, more farming and cattle, a new house, happiness to kin. Debilitated or combust, or in the 8th or 12th from the lagna with or aspected by malefics: loss of wealth, wounds, thieves, snakes, weapons, gout, distress to father and brothers, quarrels with co-partners, loss of kin, coarse food, going abroad, needless spending. In the 2nd or lord of the 7th or 8th: great distress, dependence on others, fear of premature death. Remedies: homa and the gift of a bull.

summary: Rahu's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 2 years 10 months 6 days) is described in all the general texts as difficult: quarrels, mental and physical pain, disease in the limbs, fevers, losses to rulers, robbers and enemies, foreign travel and loss of house or land. BPHS gives a better start (wealth, crops, pilgrimage) if Rahu is with the lagna lord or a yogakaraka, exalted, or in a kendra or the 11th from the lagna or Saturn, and wealth and honour in certain signs. Association with the 2nd or 7th lord brings bodily distress.
common_outcomes: quarrels, mental agony, physical distress, friction with sons, fear of disease, needless spending, discord with relations, danger from government, foreign journeys, loss of house and fields (BPHS 57.63-64)
deceitful conduct, danger of diabetes or venereal disease, enlarged spleen, persistent fever, wounds (Phaladeepika 21.55)
disease in every limb, damage by robbers, enemies and greedy rulers, loss of wealth (Jataka Parijata 18.130; Raman p. 263)
rare_outcomes: elephants, opulence and royal favour when Rahu is in certain signs (BPHS 57.68)
loss of younger brothers in an accident (Rath, Crux, one chart example)

by_area.personality: Mental agony and quarrels (BPHS 57.63); deceitful conduct (Phaladeepika 21.55).
by_area.career: Danger from the government (BPHS 57.64); cordiality with rulers in the middle if well placed (BPHS 57.67, Santhanam); damage by greedy rulers (Jataka Parijata 18.130).
by_area.finance: Needless spending, loss of house and fields (BPHS 57.64); loss of wealth to robbers and rulers (Jataka Parijata 18.130; Raman); wealth, crops and cattle at the start when well placed (BPHS 57.65-67).
by_area.health: Physical distress and fear of disease (BPHS 57.63); diabetes or venereal disease, enlarged spleen, persistent fever, wounds (Phaladeepika 21.55); disease in every limb (Jataka Parijata 18.130).
by_area.family: Discord with close relations (BPHS 57.64); family well-being when Rahu is well placed (BPHS 57.67).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to deities and Brahmins and pilgrimage at the start when Rahu is well placed (BPHS 57.66).

strengtheners: Rahu with the lagna lord or a yogakaraka (BPHS 57.65)
Rahu exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.65)
Rahu in a kendra or the 11th from the lagna or from Saturn (BPHS 57.65)
Rahu in Aries, Virgo, Cancer, Taurus, Pisces or Sagittarius (BPHS 57.68; the Sanskrit gloss adds Leo)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu not exalted or otherwise well placed (BPHS 57.63-64)
Rahu associated with the lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 57.69)
Rahu 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
lagna_or_context_notes: Santhanam notes that even in the listed signs Rahu must be well placed from the lagna or from Saturn and unafflicted. Rath (citing Sarvartha Chintamani) treats Rahu like Saturn when applying the 6th-from-Saturn rule. Nodes own no sign in this library's facts, so Rahu's 'own sign' cannot be checked.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.63-70, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: If Rahu is not exalted or otherwise well placed: quarrels, mental agony, physical distress, friction with sons, fear of disease, needless spending, discord with relations, danger from government, foreign journeys, loss of house and fields. With the lagna lord or a yogakaraka, exalted or in its own sign, or in a kendra or the 11th from the lagna or Saturn: enjoyment, wealth, more crops, devotion, pilgrimage, more cattle and family well-being at the start; cordiality with the ruler and happiness from friends in the middle. In Aries, Virgo, Cancer, Taurus, Pisces or Sagittarius: elephants, opulence, cordial relations with government, valuable clothes. With the 2nd or 7th lord: physical distress. Remedies: Mrityunjaya japa and the gift of a goat.

disagreements: For a well-placed Rahu, Santhanam reads the middle of the sub-period as cordiality with the ruler and happiness from friends; the Sanskrit gloss reads it as fear of government and conflict with sons and friends. The Sanskrit gloss adds Leo to the good signs of verse 68. Apart from BPHS, all sources give only adverse results.
phrasing_guidance: Present this as a long, testing phase: advise care with health, documents, officials and property dealings, and steady routines for the mind. Give the BPHS better version only when the chart has the listed placements. Avoid naming specific diseases as predictions.

phases: BPHS 57.65-67: when Rahu is well placed, the start brings wealth, crops and pilgrimage; Santhanam makes the middle cordial with rulers and friends, while the Sanskrit gloss makes it a time of fear from the government and conflict with sons and friends.

summary: Jupiter's sub-period, the last in Saturn's dasha (about 2 years 6 months 12 days), is good in every general source: devotion to gods and teachers, royal favour, rank, family happiness and more wealth and grain. BPHS makes it good when Jupiter is in a kendra or trikona, exalted or in its own sign, or with the lagna lord, or 5th, 9th, 11th, 2nd or a kendra from Saturn. It is bad when Jupiter is debilitated, with malefics or in a dusthana. As 2nd or 7th lord, BPHS warns of death in the family.
themes: relief at the end of the period
common_outcomes: devotion to gods and Brahmins, happiness with wife and children, great increase in wealth and grain (Phaladeepika 21.56)
devotion to gods and Brahmins, royal favour, great happiness, attainment of rank (Jataka Parijata 18.131)
worship of gods and holy people, family happiness, bodily comforts, goals met with help from superiors, a larger family circle, rank (Raman p. 263)
rare_outcomes: fame in the country, Vedic and Vedanta study, performance of sacrifices (BPHS 57.76-78)
imprisonment and fines when Jupiter is weak in a dusthana from Saturn (BPHS 57.79-80)
[maraka: BPHS 57.81 predicts death of the native or a family member when Jupiter is the 2nd or 7th lord]

by_area.personality: Religious-mindedness (BPHS 57.77); mental agony and quarrels when weak and badly placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.79).
by_area.career: Success all round, reverence and gains through government (BPHS 57.71-73, 57.76-77); rank (Jataka Parijata 18.131); help from superiors (Raman); friction with officials, failed projects, loss of position when afflicted (BPHS 57.74-75, 57.79).
by_area.finance: Conveyances, ornaments, clothes, opulence (BPHS 57.72, 57.76); more wealth and grain (Phaladeepika 21.56); loss of wealth and fines when afflicted (BPHS 57.75, 57.80).
by_area.health: Bodily comforts (Raman); disease such as leprosy (skin disease) when afflicted from the lagna (BPHS 57.75); bodily and mental illness as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.81).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children (BPHS 57.73, 57.76; Phaladeepika 21.56); distress to wife and son when Jupiter is weak and badly placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.80).
by_area.family: Family well-being and a larger family circle (BPHS 57.71; Raman); death of near relations when afflicted (BPHS 57.75).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to deities and the guru, company of the learned (BPHS 57.73); Vedas, Vedanta, sacrifices and charity of grain (BPHS 57.77-78); worship of gods and Brahmins (Phaladeepika 21.56; Jataka Parijata 18.131).

strengtheners: Jupiter in a kendra or trikona, with the lagna lord, exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.71)
Jupiter in the 5th, 9th, 11th, 2nd or a kendra from Saturn (BPHS 57.76)
Jupiter in the 11th (BPHS 57.71, Sanskrit gloss)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter debilitated, with malefics, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 57.74-75)
Jupiter weak and in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn (BPHS 57.79-80)
Jupiter as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.81)
Jupiter 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS uses two reference points: Jupiter from the lagna (vv. 71-75) and from Saturn (vv. 76-80). Jupiter rules the 2nd or 7th for Aquarius, Scorpio, Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where BPHS 57.81 applies. Rath gives an example in which a long court dispute through Saturn's dasa ended favourably once Jupiter's sub-period began near its end.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.71-82, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if Jupiter is in a kendra or trikona, with the lagna lord, or in its own or exaltation sign: success, family well-being, conveyances, ornaments and clothes from the government, reverence, devotion to deities and the guru, company of the learned, happiness from wife and children. Debilitated, with malefics or in the 6th/8th/12th from the lagna: death of near relations, loss of wealth, friction with officials, failed projects, foreign journeys, disease such as leprosy. In the 5th, 9th, 11th, 2nd or a kendra from Saturn: opulence, happiness to the wife, gains through government, good food and clothes, religious-mindedness, fame, Vedas and Vedanta, sacrifices, charity of grain. Weak and 6th/8th/12th from Saturn: friction with kin, mental agony, quarrels, loss of position and ventures, fines, imprisonment, distress to wife and son. As 2nd or 7th lord: physical distress, agony, death of the native or a family member. Remedies: Shiva Sahasranama and a gift of gold.

disagreements: All sources agree this is a favourable sub-period by default. Only BPHS gives adverse versions, under affliction or as a maraka.
phrasing_guidance: Present this as a supportive close to Saturn's period, good for family, faith, learning, recognition and resolving long-running matters. Mention the cautions only when the chart shows the BPHS afflictions. Do not predict the death of the native or family members.
